'''July 2000 Cedar Grove tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Cedar Grove, NJ on 8 July 2000. It is known from Ted Panczyszyn's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d987">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-09-cedar-grove-nj-7-8-2000d987/ cedar-grove-nj-7-8-2000], DeckTech (Ted "Rogue15" Panczyszyn, 9 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-09-cedar-grove-nj-7-8-2000d987/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 8 July 2000
* '''Site:''' Cedar Grove, NJ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
